items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he used to – after Halston wasn’t there, he was there.

ctx.x: You’re out of my league now.
Oh, wow. Well, I can’t remember his name, but anyway, he used to – after Halston wasn’t there, he was there. [Ms. Wilson later remembers Kevan Hall.]
Your taste, is that also part of the gift? Who did you – how did you come to develop such a sense of presentation?
